items.text: Bad career advice usually sounds confident, ignores your situation and comes from someone who gains if you follow it, so the safest habit is to judge any advice by who gives it, what they gain, what evidence they show and how easily you can undo the step.
Ask four questions of any advice: who is saying it, what do they gain, what is the evidence and can I reverse it if it fails.
Check official pages and live notices before acting on advice, including advice on this site.
